analysis.title: ETF Compass: Cross-asset ETF vol diagnostics
key_insights: Barclays' rich-vol screen is topped by international equity ETFs (TUR, EEM, ASHR, EWW) and commodity ETFs (UNG, USO). Financial ETFs (XLF, KRE) and IWM rank among the cheapest on volatility.
Week over week to 10-Nov-2026, short-dated vol was broadly stable across assets and skew flattened across the board. US equity vol moved modestly higher, particularly relative to longer-dated vol.
Commodity volatility is elevated compared with its long-term average. Skew across assets except rates is flatter than its long-term average.
Vol term structure across assets is slightly above long-term averages. Options activity is materially above long-term levels in rates and below long-term levels in commodities.
Across asset classes, skew is flat versus long-term levels, while vol and normalized open interest remain slightly above their long-term averages.
Credit ETF volatility risk premium is currently above its long-term average.
Inter-sector US equity realized correlation sits at the 1st percentile and cross-asset correlation at the 88th percentile of their histories.

In Barclays' tail-hedge screen, XLF, HYG and IYR puts offer the best value against historical 2-month drawdowns in global equities, Big Tech and EM equities. For Chinese equities the best are XLF, HYG and FXI, and for commodities HYG, XLF and XOP.

sector_views.rationale: XLF and KRE options rank among the cheapest on volatility, and XLF puts rank as a top tail hedge by historical payout per unit of cost.

trade_ideas.description: Buy short-dated (~2-month 25-delta) puts on XLF, HYG or IYR as tail hedges against global equity, Big Tech and EM equity drawdowns
trade_ideas.rationale: At current costs these puts would have offered the best payout relative to historical 2-month drawdowns in the benchmarks.

trade_ideas.description: Buy short-dated puts on XLF, HYG or FXI as tail hedges against Chinese equities
trade_ideas.rationale: These offered the best value against historical 2-month drawdowns in Chinese equities at current costs.

trade_ideas.description: Buy short-dated puts on HYG, XLF or XOP as tail hedges against commodities
trade_ideas.rationale: These offered the best value against historical 2-month drawdowns in commodities at current costs.

risk_factors: Past performance, including the historical drawdown payouts behind the hedge screen, is not necessarily indicative of future results.
Elevated cross-asset correlation (88th percentile) alongside very low US sector correlation (1st percentile).
